topics.topic: Scope of the “Email of any kind” prohibition for staff login-email responsibilities
questions: Does “Email of any kind” prohibit only email delivery/challenge mechanisms, or also the login-email normalization, uniqueness and replacement responsibilities explicitly assigned to `staff_identity`?

Does “Email of any kind” prohibit only email messaging/challenge/delivery behavior, or also the login-email normalization, uniqueness, lookup, verified-mark, and replacement behavior assigned to `staff_identity`?

quotes:
A16 and the staff rows of A3 and A11: staff account creation by an
administrator, login and staff session issue, resolution and sign-out,
session revocation, status transitions with their cascade (sessions
revoked), password change, project assignment and its revocation, and the
administrative recovery override, the one replacement of a login email (A10,
Factory `3080ef0dbe73`). Session TTL is A30's.

Email of any kind (there is none, A10), project authorization, viewer or
service credentials, HTTP cookies or headers, or role-capability tables. It
sends no notice.
judgement.why: The ownership passage assigns login-email replacement to `staff_identity`, while its prohibition literally excludes every email responsibility from that module.

bases.rests_on:
The exceptional recovery override is an administrator action that replaces a
staff account's login email with a given address, sets its "email verified" mark (R0-23), and is
audited as `staff.recovery_override` atomically with the change; it is the
one operation that changes a login email, and an exceptional one (accepted
contract `perform_recovery_override`).

bases.passage:
Email of any kind (there is none, A10), project authorization, viewer or
service credentials, HTTP cookies or headers, or role-capability tables. It
sends no notice.
bases.rests_on:
The portal has no staff email challenge: no email verification, no email
change confirmed at a new address, no password-reset token and no security
notification, and it sends no email (`00_product.md` R0-03, R0-23).

witness.initial: An active administrator and an active staff account with an existing normalized login email exist.
events: The administrator invokes `perform_recovery_override` with an unused replacement email.
The account holder attempts to authenticate using the replacement email and current password.
outcomes: The ownership passage makes `staff_identity` normalize and replace the login email, after which authentication using the replacement succeeds.
The prohibition prevents `staff_identity` from owning any email behavior, leaving the replacement unavailable or without an owning module and authentication using it unsuccessful.
witness.observer: The administrator and the staff account holder.
basis:
The exceptional recovery override is an administrator action that replaces a
staff account's login email with a given address, sets its "email verified" mark (R0-23), and is
audited as `staff.recovery_override` atomically with the change; it is the
one operation that changes a login email, and an exceptional one (accepted
contract `perform_recovery_override`).

topics.topic: Authoritative HTTP route catalog and count after challenge/reset route removal
questions: What is the authoritative post-removal HTTP route catalog: were the six former challenge/reset routes removed from the 56-route backend, and if so what is its new route count and exact route set?

quotes:
- **Route table** is `rules.http_router_backend` (56 routes, 49 table and 7
  irregular, in the accepted spec; 50 and 43 since the six challenge routes
  left on 2026-11-07, R0-23) instead of the former `rules.http_route_catalog`; administrator
  project discovery `GET /admin/projects` is added (R0-08).
judgement.why: State 5 explicitly removes the six challenge routes and gives the resulting authoritative counts of 50 total routes, comprising 43 table routes and 7 irregular routes.
